decision.reason: ITmedia interviews Japan Oracle on Applied Engineering and debates FDE outcome-based compensation; an independently buildable customer acceptance/proof workflow is hypothesized, marked as editorial commentary rather than new legal obligation.
decision.article_title: 「FDEは“成果報酬”にすべきだ」 日本オラクル社長に筆者の持論をぶつけてみた - ITmedia

opportunities.core_job: Document measurable business outcomes and handover signoff for embedded technical engineering vendor projects
opportunities.target_customer: Enterprise CIO/IT procurement executives buying FDE/Applied Engineering services
opportunities.product_mechanism: Statement-of-work baseline → deliverable/operational KPI → customer-supplied evidence and human signoff → milestone/acceptance report
opportunities.why_now: October 13 ITmedia report evaluates Japan Oracle's Applied Engineering initiative and argues performance-based FDE compensation might better align incentives; this is an opinion, not enacted policy
opportunities.before_state: FDE success and client responsibility are evaluated through vague service statements and subjective claims
opportunities.after_state: Versioned SOW-to-outcome evidence and signoff, without any LLM inference or code execution

source_observations.observation: ITmedia interviews Japan Oracle representatives about Applied Engineering and raises outcome-based billing; opinion attribution is explicit.
